prompt:
A cinematic storyboard sheet for a Sri Lankan television drama: 5 photorealistic film stills of ONE scene, laid out in a grid 3 panels across and 2 down, read left to right, then top to bottom. Every panel is a landscape 16:9 still of the same size, separated by thin, even, plain white gutters. All panels are the same moment's world, painted together: the same people, props, weather, light and colour grade in every panel.

Reference images, in order: image 1 is the location plate for Colombo roadside; image 2 is the reference sheet for phone. Take from image 1: the kind of place: its ground, water, plants, structures and materials. It is ONE view of the place; each panel has its own camera position, so do not repeat this view in every panel; image 2: phone exactly as shown.

People (every panel): every person is a smooth, matte, faceless artist's mannequin in one solid colour, with jointed limbs and simple hands: Kasun is the red mannequin; Anudi is the blue mannequin. A small raised ridge on the front of the head, where a nose would be, shows which way the head faces. Each mannequin has the person's real height and build and sits, stands and holds things exactly as a real person would. No faces, no hair, no clothes, no skin: only the mannequin colour. Everything else (the place, the props, the light, the weather) is a real, photorealistic film still.

World (every panel): Paint one storyboard image with three columns and two rows of equal vertical 9:16 panels, read left to right across the upper row, then the lower row; leave the lower-right cell blank. Use narrow plain gutters, with no lettering, numbers, symbols or arrows anywhere. Kasun is a medium-height, lean red artist's mannequin; Anudi is an average-height, slender blue artist's mannequin. Render both as smooth, featureless figures, identified through colour and pose. The Colombo roadside is wet under soft, overcast early-morning light, with fine drizzle, cool grey shadows, muted green and beige surfaces, and restrained amber shop illumination. Paint the setting and props realistically: patched asphalt, concrete pavement, open kerb drainage, weathered masonry, a dark-green three-wheeler with a black canopy, Anudi's open navy umbrella, and her structured tan handbag with brass-coloured fittings and an open exterior pocket. The orange smartphone has the reference image's camera arrangement and transparent cover, without readable markings. Anudi always carries the umbrella in her left hand and the handbag on her right shoulder; the phone begins in her right hand and is subsequently carried in Kasun's right hand.

Geography: The action follows one pavement from the vending bay at screen left toward a quieter frontage at screen right. The three-wheeler is parked beside the bay, with its rear wheel adjacent to the phone's landing patch on the walking edge. A shallow open drain follows the kerb across the lower-left side of the wider views. Behind the bay, a small amber-lit shop beneath a blue awning gives way toward screen right to a long weathered concrete boundary wall with a distinctive moss-darkened base, ending farther along at a pale-green concrete post. This wall remains on frame right through the successive positions, connecting the bay, Kasun's pursuit and the encounter. All cameras remain on the road-facing side of the action line, looking across or slightly diagonally toward the pavement and frontages; travel remains across the image toward screen right.

PANEL 1 (row 1, column 1) — Standing eye height at the road-facing pavement edge, looking obliquely across the walking line toward the bay; wide full-figure composition with a 28mm lens feel. Background: The three-wheeler occupies the left third beneath the shop's blue awning and amber light. The weathered boundary wall and its moss-darkened base extend across frame right; the kerb and open drain enter at lower left. The blue Anudi mannequin is mid-step just left of centre, travelling across the panel toward screen right, with chest and head directed right. Her left hand grips the open umbrella above her head, while her right hand holds the orange phone immediately beside the handbag's open exterior pocket on her right hip. The red Kasun mannequin stands beside the three-wheeler at frame left, chest and head in right-facing profile, left hand resting against the vehicle frame and right hand hanging beside his thigh. Hold both full figures, the handbag pocket and the clear road surface together, with the shop behind frame left and the long weathered wall behind frame right.
PANEL 2 (row 1, column 2) — Approximately 20 centimetres above the kerb, on the same road-facing side of the axis, looking slightly upward across the walking line; low wide composition with a 35mm lens feel. Background: The three-wheeler's rear wheel and lower bodywork anchor frame left, with the open drain immediately below. The blue awning is confined to upper left, while the same moss-based concrete wall occupies upper right. The blue Anudi mannequin occupies the right third in a rightward stride, chest and head directed across frame right. Her left hand holds the navy umbrella overhead and slightly low, while her right hand still holds the orange phone at the handbag pocket on her right hip. The rear wheel borders frame left, and an empty patch of wet asphalt lies clearly between the wheel and Anudi beneath her hand, with the drain at lower left and the weathered wall at upper right.
PANEL 3 (row 1, column 3) — Standing eye-height position on the road-facing side, angled downward toward Kasun's lower body; ground-inclusive medium composition with a 50mm lens feel, cropped from lower chest to feet. Background: Three-wheeler bodywork and part of its rear wheel border frame left. Wet pavement fills the lower background, the drain remains lower left, and a narrow section of the moss-darkened wall is visible at upper right. The red Kasun mannequin stands left of centre with chest angled toward screen right, both feet planted beside the kerb and his upper body cropped above the lower chest. His right hand hangs beside his right thigh, fingers directed toward the ground, while his left hand rests loosely beside his left thigh. The orange phone lies flat beside his right foot with its transparent-covered back and camera circles visible, separated clearly from the three-wheeler wheel at frame left; the drain stays lower left and the wall remains upper right.
PANEL 4 (row 2, column 1) — Standing eye height, slightly ahead and on the road-facing side of Kasun, looking diagonally back across his route; chest-up medium composition with a 35mm lens feel and a readable three-quarter front angle. Background: The bay's blue awning and amber shop opening appear small and softened at far left. The next stretch of the same weathered concrete wall fills frame right, retaining its recognisable dark staining and surface texture. The red Kasun mannequin fills the centre in a running pose directed across frame toward screen right, chest angled right in three-quarter view and head turned along that same rightward line. His bent right arm brings the orange phone into the lower-right corner, held securely with its covered back visible, while his bent left arm places his left hand at the lower-left edge. Leave space ahead of his head on the right, with the amber-lit bay distant at far left and the continuous weathered wall behind frame right.
PANEL 5 (row 2, column 2) — Standing eye height on the road-facing side, squared across the action line; medium two-shot with a 50mm lens feel, including the umbrella canopy, both figures' hands and the gap between them. Background: The continuous weathered wall remains behind frame right and ends at a pale-green concrete post near the right edge. The earlier amber-lit frontage is distant at far left, with a short section of kerb and drain visible at lower left. The blue Anudi mannequin stands at frame right beneath the open umbrella, chest and head still directed screen right, with her left hand gripping the umbrella shaft and her empty right hand beside the handbag on her right hip. The red Kasun mannequin enters from frame left in a rightward step, chest and head directed toward Anudi. His right hand carries the orange phone forward at waist height, still well short of her hand, while his left hand hangs slightly behind his hip. Keep a clear gap between them, the drain at lower left and the same weathered wall with its pale-green end post behind frame right.

Bodies (every panel): each person sits or stands the way a real person does the task in front of them, never posed for the camera. The body faces the task and only the head turns: someone at a steering wheel sits squarely behind it, the wheel centred in front of the chest, back against the seat, both hands on the rim; someone at a desk sits square to it; someone at a stove faces the stove. A camera beside a person sees the body side-on, not the chest. Nobody looks into or faces the lens unless the panel says so. Head and eyes turn together: the eyes never roll hard to one side while the face points at the camera; a near-frontal face looks just past the lens.

Draw NO text of any kind: no panel numbers, no captions, no titles, no timestamps, no arrows, no labels, no borders other than the gutters. The people, place and everyday details are Sri Lankan.
